skill_name: Write a 5-sentence description of online shopping.
workflow: Online shopping is the process of buying goods and services from a computer or smartphone. It is a convenient alternative to traditional shopping, as customers can purchase goods and services from anywhere in the world with an internet connection. goods and services can be ordered and paid for via credit or debit card and the order is usually completed within a day or two. Online shopping also allows customers to compare prices of products from different stores, read customer reviews and reviews
